name: Gatus
description: Monitor endpoint conditions and publish a status page with persistent history.

files.gatus.yaml:
web:
  port: 8080
storage:
  type: sqlite
  path: /data/gatus.db
metrics: true
ui:
  title: Service status
endpoints:
  - name: Gatus
    group: Internal
    url: http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
    interval: 60s
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"

instructions: Review the portable Compose and native configuration before starting.
The default listener is local-only. Add an authenticated HTTPS proxy before exposing private data.
Edit endpoint conditions, alerts, authentication and storage in App settings. Native YAML remains portable.
